title: Thastock
description: AI second opinion on any US stock: bull case, bear case, verdict and the live numbers behind them.

tools.name: analyze_stock
tools.description: Get Thastock's AI analysis of a US-listed stock: the current price, an AI verdict (bullish, neutral or bearish) with a confidence score, the strongest bull case and bear case, and the live numbers behind them (RSI, 50/200-day moving averages, 52-week position, earnings beat rate, insider buying or selling, analyst ratings, news tone). Use it when someone asks whether a stock looks good or bad, wants both sides of a stock, or asks for a second opinion before buying. Educational, not financial advice.

symbol.description: US stock ticker symbol, for example NVDA, AAPL or BRK.B
